raw_snippet: In sequential learning experiments, SDFT enables a single model to accumulate multiple skills over time without performance regression, establishing on-policy distillation as a practical path to continual learning from demonstrations.
note: Shenfeld, Damani, Hübotter, Agrawal (MIT/ETH); v2 2026-08-07. On-policy self-distillation from demonstrations with skills pooling without forgetting: the L5 'pool without forgetting' observable, demonstrated in research.
